register.reg_condition: when FEAT_FGT2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Trap execution of any of the following AArch64 instructions at EL1 and EL0 to EL2:
This field is ignored by the PE and treated as zero when all of the following are true:

field_value_description.para: Execution of the specified instructions is not trapped by this mechanism.

If EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state, and the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is not {1, 1}, then execution at EL1 and EL0 using AArch64 of any of the specified instructions is trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x18, unless the instruction generates a higher priority exception.

field_reset_condition.condition: the highest implemented Exception level is EL2
